verdict.rationale: Formant is a cloud fleet-management platform, so self-hosting is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows installing the on-device Formant agent via Docker, which is a client component and not the core platform. The API console and data uploads point to Formant's production cloud (api.formant.io), and nothing documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
